title: Exact admissible-value bounds for missing inputs in an interpretable fuzzy additive prescreening model (NHANES): code, knowledge schema and results
description: Code, JSON-LD knowledge schema, analysis protocol and results for a fuzzy additive model that prescreens elevated depressive symptoms (PHQ-9 >= 10) from non-symptom NHANES survey data, with exact admissible-value bounds for missing inputs (Algorithm 1) and bound-guided input acquisition (Algorithm 2). Includes the statistics file that populates the manuscript.
